correctness.rationale: Reconstructed M=(2D+A)/6 on the explicit nonbipartite graph. Exact inverse row at a missing-edge endpoint consists of (α,β,−γ,−γ,−δ repeated q), and at ordinary endpoint consists of four −δ, D and q−1 copies −E. Kernel L¹ integrals are elementary |affine| formulas. Independent symbolic SymPy simplification of endpoint-minus-ordinary, L1−L2, L2−L0 returned respective integer-coefficient polynomials (8,168,...,64194), (16,248,...,975) and (4,80,...,5850), each with strictly positive denominator and all positive coefficients for q>0; exact degrees 12,9,11. The kernel is affine in evaluation point, and interior strictness follows from opposite-signed kernels on positive measure. Leading terms give 1/6 and 2/3 without relying on q≤7 checks.

value.rationale: The exact effect of successive distinct deletions on a natural metric-graph spline projector is a motivated sensitivity problem. Strict L0<L2<L1 and two different asymptotic orders reveal genuine nonmonotone shielding, not a substitution into a known complete-graph formula.

final_claim: Exact sharp L∞ norm of the L² affine spline projector on unit metric K_{q+4} with two disjoint edges removed, attained exactly at deletion endpoints; all q≥1 shielding L0(q)<L2(q)<L1(q), limits q(L2-L0)→1/6 and q³(L1-L2)→2/3.
limitations: Unit equal edge length/measure, no vertex masses, q≥1, real affine splines only.
No stronger claims on general deleted matchings, arbitrary weights, or other projector classes.
